policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Malawi as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Malawian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Malawian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Malawian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Panama stamped visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Malawi in its stamped-visa cohort, separately from the authorized-visa cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Malawian passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The cited Embassy says stamped-visa approval may take up to 30 business days and the visa is stamped in the passport at the consulate if granted.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
